name: firefly/eda-kafka
description: LaraFly eda Kafka adapter: a KafkaEventPublisher + consumer over the OPTIONAL ext-rdkafka (suggest + extension_loaded guard — never a hard require), auto-configured behind firefly.eda.provider=kafka, with a DLT topic for exhausted retries and a KafkaHealthIndicator.

suggest.ext-rdkafka: Required ONLY to activate the Kafka adapter (firefly.eda.provider=kafka). Needs librdkafka >= 1.5.3. Absent = the adapter is inert; the default gate + non-Kafka consumers never need it.
